title: The Dark Truth About Carmen Winstead #Shorts
description:
Nihilism is not the conclusion of Carmen Winstead — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. An urban legend or urban myth is a modern genre of folklore. It often consists of fictional stories associated with the macabre, superstitions, ghosts, demons, cryptids, extraterrestrials, creepypasta, and other fear generating narrative elements.

The psychology underneath Carmen Winstead is simpler and older than the story on top. The curse of the Bambino was a superstition evolving from the failure of the Boston Red Sox baseball team to win the World Series in the 86-year period from 1918 to 2004. While some fans took the curse seriously, most used the expression in a tongue-in-cheek manner.
